sources.locator: Complete 32-page paper; §1.2–1.5 PDF pp. 4–7; §2 PDF pp. 7–12; §3.1–3.3 PDF pp. 16–27; §4 PDF pp. 28–31.

contents.name: Finite discounted MDP, reward bounds, values, and admissible heuristic

Admissible upper heuristic and normalized value cap
R-MAX empirical model and finite value iteration
Delayed Q-learning batch update and learn flags
Adaptive reward and transition concentration, including the online-sampling qualification
contents.reason: The paper delegates the online-sampling justification; the item proves a potential-stream coupling and conditional-martingale bounds locally.

contents.name: Value simulation bound under reward and transition estimation error
Known-state MDP, escape event, and generic PAC reduction
R-MAX high-probability empirical-model accuracy
contents.reason: The paper cites a multinomial inequality and defers the adaptive-sampling proof; this item proves the required bounds locally.

contents.name: Delayed Q-learning optimism, update count, and residual event
contents.reason: The published per-pair count omits one possible zero-slack update; the local lemma includes the necessary one-update-per-pair floor.

contents.name: R-MAX sample-complexity theorem and heuristic-dependent count
contents.reason: The proof uses safe value-iteration and escape-event tolerances; the value cap is normalized to at least one.

contents.name: Delayed Q-learning heuristic-dependent sample-complexity theorem
contents.reason: The theorem uses positive accuracy and the corrected additive per-pair update floor.

contents.name: Lower-bound discussion in §4
contents.reason: The assigned pair is the two upper-bound algorithms and their examples; no lower-bound claim is made.

contents.name: Known-state/action MDP and the exact value of dedicated absorbing states
Printed nonnegative accuracy endpoint beside singular finite sample formulas; separately proved local zero-tolerance boundary
contents.reason: The source prints the endpoint in Theorems11/16, while §1.5 requires positive accuracy. The new item supplies local finite coupling and algorithm counterexamples, plus the zero-value success branch; these are not attributed as source proofs.

contents.name: Delayed Q-learning algorithm and original initialization

contents.reason: The paper provides the uniform-heuristic proof route. This item re-proves the arbitrary-admissible-heuristic refinement, uses the smaller tolerance required by the local escape lemma, and corrects the zero-slack per-pair update count.
